# Assumptions and terms

- Inputs to be supplied by the client, and when.
- Work excluded from the quotation. Work beyond this scope would be quoted at the daily rate.
- Meetings included, and whether delivery is remote.
- Indicative and non-binding, to be reconfirmed on award. Rates may be revised if work begins more than twelve months after the date of this quotation.
- Invoiced in instalments on delivery of named deliverables, payable within 30 days.
